summary: Grizzly Time now reads the Rush: every peer subscribes GrizzlyRushActionExecutor.OnRam and opens its own keg for a ramming hull, GrizzlyTimeKegs restates ramRadius 16 and duration 1 (a test reads them back off GrizzlyRushAction.asset), and the AI presses Rush on straights. No vessel file changed. Your lane's branches (project-thread-ge80ea, 1uj8e9) share no file with it.
why: Fun pass on Grizzly Time (Yash): Rush is the Grizzly's Time ability and the Time game did not use it. Also found, for your decision: Energy (0.05/s against a 0.25 cost) caps a Rush to one per 5 s, so the Time level does not change how often a Grizzly can Rush in a race (GRIZZLYTIME.md section 0.1).
